mapper.select: SELECT CONVERT(AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(USER_NAME), #{P_SECURITY_KEY}) USING UTF8) AS USER_NAME FROM USER_INFO WHERE USER_ID = #{P_USER_ID} AND USER_PASSWORD = SHA2(CONCAT(#{P_USER_PASSWORD}, UPDATE_DT, REG_DT ), 256);
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ACCESS_HIS (USER_ID, EVENT_DT, ACCESS_TYPE, IP_ADDRESS, DEVICE_TYPE) VALUES (#{P_USER_ID}, CONVERT_TZ(NOW(3), @@GLOBAL.TIME_ZONE, 'ASIA/SEOUL'), #{P_ACCESS_TYPE}, #{P_IP_ADDRESS}, #{P_DEVICE_TYPE})
mapper.select: SELECT ML.MENU_ID, ML.MENU_NAME, ML.P_MENU_ID, ML.URL_PATH, ML.MENU_DEPTH FROM USER_INFO AS UI INNER JOIN MENU_BY_ROLE AS MR ON UI.ROLE_ID = MR.ROLE_ID INNER JOIN MENU_LIST AS ML ON MR.MENU_ID = ML.MENU_ID WHERE UI.USER_ID = #{P_USER_ID} ORDER BY ML.SORT_NO;
